home_title: Moss Garden — a healing garden that grows on its own
home_desc: Moss Garden is a healing idle game, now in development. Water a small moss garden; it grows on its own, and new plants and decorations unlock as it grows.
hero_h1: Water it. It grows on its own.
hero_lead: Moss Garden is a slow, healing garden for your phone. Water a small moss garden and watch it grow on its own. New plants and decorations unlock as the garden grows, and it keeps growing even while you are away.
hero_note: Coming soon. The game is still in development: there is no store page or release date yet, and details may change.
card1_p: One tap is a watering. Simple, calm, and quick to learn.
card2_p: Your garden grows even while you are away, so something new is waiting when you come back.
card3_p: When the garden has grown, a new season begins: the garden starts fresh, and lasting bonuses remain.
shots_note: Screenshots coming soon — the garden is still growing.
fact1: A healing idle game, single player.
fact2: Tap to water; the garden grows on its own, even offline.
fact3: New plants and decorations unlock as the garden grows, collected in a plant encyclopedia.
fact4: The garden's look changes with the time of day and the season.
fact5: For iOS. No release date yet.
release_desc: What each TestFlight build of Moss Garden changes, newest first. The in-app Settings menu is the source of truth for testers.
